raw_request: reset appsdk,从头开始建立appsdk开发管控
understood_objective: Rebuild AgentTeams development governance in an isolated worktree, preserving accepted architecture and replacing inherited placeholder and parent-repository assumptions with real local validation and artifact production.
acceptance_criteria: Initialize current official AppSDK resources without reusing historical admission records.
Bind project architecture maps, ownership, real test/build commands and compiled artifacts.
Run the complete existing test inventory, current standalone typechecks and package builds.
Compile Guidance and AppSDK and verify contracts; governance validation is not runtime readiness.
Review the validated candidate; preserve main and other worktrees. Commit, merge and deployment are separate delivery states.
non_goals: Implement daemon, relay, resource scheduling or provider runtime in this reset.
Publish or freeze a runtime release.
Reuse or build the retired host UI as the new Console.
Modify credential stores or upstream providers.
assumptions: One source admission unit contains existing code; semantic ownership stays in docs/architecture/module-registry.json.
Console is optional; passive capability Agents and one-to-many work are first-class.
First release includes public network, NAT and relay; live runtime gates remain pending.
